**In one line**: Bitcoin miner TeraWulf (WULF) is reportedly signing a roughly US$19 billion compute-supply deal with Anthropic and buying a power plant, accelerating its shift into AI data centers.

### Key points
- TeraWulf reportedly struck a large ~US$19 billion agreement to supply AI compute capacity to Anthropic.
- The company also acquired a power plant to redirect cheap mining electricity toward AI training and inference data centers.
- The deal is read as a signal that TeraWulf is pivoting from crypto mining toward leasing AI infrastructure.

### Why it matters
Surging compute demand from major AI firms like Anthropic is pushing miners to convert idle power and sites into AI data centers. It points to a new supply source emerging in an AI infrastructure race bottlenecked by GPUs and power.
